subject: Key custody & encryption intake — Clover Health

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Key custody & encryption intake — Clover Health

Hi Sam — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so our security and platform teams can scope the work for the pilot/POC.

Recap (from our side)
- Clover is evaluating Redwood for inference on PHI-adjacent workloads and wants clarity on key custody options and encryption controls.
- You mentioned SOC 2 posture + a GDPR DPA and that HIPAA applicability is being assessed by legal.

High-priority items we need to confirm before the next step:
1) SOC 2: current status (Type II date or in-progress) and whether you can share report or AICPA letter.
2) Encryption at-rest: algorithm and key management — are you using provider-managed KMS (e.g., AWS KMS) today or do you have customer-managed keys (CMK) / BYOK in place?
3) HSM usage: do you use CloudHSM or an on-prem HSM for master key material? Any FIPS/CSP attestation docs available?
4) Key rotation & export: rotation cadence, ability to rotate without service interruption, and whether key material is exportable/importable.
5) Audit logs & separation: can you provide cryptographic audit logs (KMS key usage, key admin ops) and any evidence of separation of duties?

Next steps / asks
- Please attach your completed security questionnaire (we'll attach our vendor intake form to speed things up).
- If possible, share any SOC 2 evidence or target timeline.
- Propose a 30–45 minute technical intake next week to walk through key topology (BYOK flow, wrapping, rotation).

I've attached our redwood_vendor_intake_form.docx to give you the specific fields we usually need. If it's easier, feel free to send your questionnaire and we'll fill the rest.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internally once we have your answers.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Sam Bennett <sam.bennett@cloverhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: security@cloverhealth.com
Date: Wed, 04 Feb 2026 10:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Key custody & encryption intake — Clover Health

Hi Tessa — thanks for the clear recap. Answers inline and attaching our questionnaire for your security team: Clover_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf.

Quick answers:
- SOC 2: Type II in progress; expected completion (audit report ready) in late Q2 2026. We can provide interim bridge letters and our SOC control matrix on request.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We have a GDPR-compliant DPA (signed) and are a HIPAA-covered entity for certain product lines; legal is finalizing a BAA for vendors that need it.
- At-rest encryption: AES-256 with envelope encryption. Currently key management is AWS KMS for data keys, with multi-region CMKs backed by AWS CloudHSM.
- HSM: We use AWS CloudHSM clusters (FIPS 140-2 validated modules) for root key custody. We do not export raw key material from CloudHSM; we support key import for BYOK flows where supported by the vendor and via secure wrapping.
- Rotation: CMKs are rotated annually; data key rotation is per workload and can be configured. Rotation does not require service downtime.
- Audit logs: AWS CloudTrail + AWS KMS key usage logs are retained per account policy (we can share samples and retention windows).

Open items for us to confirm with you:
- Do you support an external KMS integration (e.g., KMIP or KMS proxy) or do you require a specific BYOK import flow?
- Any specific FIPS/CSP attestation formats you need for the HSM?

Attached: Clover_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (completed where possible). Happy to jump on the intake call — Sam (security) and I can join Thursday or Friday afternoon ET.

Regards,
Sam Bennett
Security Lead
Clover Health

Attachment: Clover_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Re: Key custody & encryption intake — Clover Health

Tessa / Neha — quick internal note after reading Sam's answers and the questionnaire they sent. Forwarding the reply for context.

Summary / proposed asks for next call (technical intake)
- Confirm whether they need a CMK/BYOK model (they said evaluating BYOK). If they expect to bring key material, we need to confirm supported import formats (AWS KMS import tokens, PKCS#11, KMIP).
- Ask for CloudHSM cluster topology and attestation PDF (we need the FIPS 140-2 validation cert + any CPA/SSA attestation they have).
- Clarify audit log retention windows and S3/CloudTrail sharing method. We'll request sample key usage logs (redacted) and the KMS key policy admin list.
- Validate rotation requirements (they say annual for CMKs) — ask whether customers will want to rotate keys from their side while Redwood continues to use the wrapped key. Need to ensure our runtime supports dynamic rewrap without dropping connections / with minimal cold starts.
- Verify they do not expect raw key export from HSM (they said no). If they need key material export, that's a non-starter and we should flag immediately.

Action items (internal):
- Neha: loop legal for BAA template + confirm specific HIPAA controls they will need in the POC.
- Tessa: schedule a 30–45m intake with Sam + their security engineer; propose Thu/Fri ET.
- Me: prepare a short KMS integration spec (1–2 pages) and a diagram of supported BYOK patterns (import -> wrap -> runtime access). I'll attach the KMS architecture diagram to the intake invite.

Vivek
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
